title: The 16-Point Seller Financing Avatar
rules: Target businesses operating for 10+ years with under $1M in profit.
Look for retiring Baby Boomer owners with no family successor.
Prioritize brick-and-mortar, boring, non-tech services (laundromats, car washes, HVAC, plumbing).
Offer structure: 10-30% down, 70-90% seller note over 3-7 years at 5-7% interest, amortized from cash flow.
Pitch the seller: An installment sale prevents a massive one-time IRS capital gains tax hit and provides a steady retirement annuity.
